protocol_notes: Oklab27 block: exp.v19.fiber_duality.extract_color_fiber_27d imported verbatim (identical math to production)

DINO768 block: DINO_TRANSFORM(Resize224/BICUBIC+CenterCrop224) + per-token L2-normalized patch moments (mean|std), replicating exp.v19.fiber_duality.extract_dino_rgb_moments_768d; local snapshot is the 257-token (no-register) dinov2-small
DINO forward runs CPU fp32; production uses CUDA fp16 autocast (fp16-vs-fp32 impact measured in proxy_gap.decode_fp16_vs_fp32 when not skipped)
S10-decoded variant uses deliver s10_p5_lowlr decoder, CPU fp32, on runs/v9_local_4070/cache/n2c_z.pt z_src rows (first occurrence per unique source); production decodes fp16 on GPU

P2 is a proxy for the exact train_4400 (pool membership lives in the remote pseudo_gt pool); 128D u-space and ConvNeXt analyses require remote exports (u128/convnext sections stay null until --u-npz/--cnx-npz provided)
DATA-03 boundary honored: analysis only, no feature branch is removed or changed

p1_eval150.population: 150 unique test750 sources (data/test JPEGs resized 512 bilinear)

proxy_gap.note: original data/test JPEG vs production path decode_s10(z_src); same 150 images

decode_fp16_vs_fp32.note: 1 latent; CPU fp16 decode is ~100x slower than fp32 on 2 threads, so the 150-image variant decodes in fp32 (diff measured here is negligible at analysis resolution)

p2_train_proxy.population: combined v18 pool population (wikiart_new_512 + distinct5_512/train, canonical-pid dedup, wikiart first) seeded sample 120/style (seed 20261120); 151 banned test750-source/reference files excluded

internal_redundancy_oklab_vs_dino.note: A=first arg, B=second arg; canonical correlations are out-of-fold (5-fold CV); ridge alpha=10; in-sample CCA with dim(A)<<dim(B) saturates at 1.0 by overfit and is not reported

p3_oneshot.note: standardization and centroids come from the P2 train proxy; this is the label-free conditioning-side geometry the One-Shot u_glob module consumes (795D standardized fiber)

cross_population.note: PCA fitted on standardized P2 (train proxy), applied to standardized P1 (eval side); 1.0 = no distribution shift
